why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items, and neither item is broken. Item 1: Check 1's PASS condition asks only that the bad file returns `{}` with no SyntaxError, that valid JSON still parses (`good.port === 9000`) and that the code catches the parse error. The valid-JSON part is a regression guard, not an extra demand on the error path. Nothing asks for the file name, the line or a warning. The file-and-line tension appears only under "Advisory (does not affect PASS/FAIL)". Item 2: the builder brief says to catch the error "and returns {} (a new empty object)". On the issue's wish for file-and-line detail, it says "Do not add behaviour beyond the acceptance lines to resolve this; just flag it for the reviewer". It never asks for a clearer thrown error. The warning against swallowing missing-file errors covers a different error, so it doesn't change what happens on a parse error.
